### Head of Product (Mail)
        **View Job URL:** https://to.indeed.com/aapsbc9bq286
        **Job Id:** JOBSEARCH_100014
        **Company:** Proton
        **Location:** Geneva, GE
        **Posted on:** July 30, 2026
        **Job Type:** None
        **Compensation:** None

        Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Purpose of the role

We're looking for a Head of Product to own the overall product strategy and roadmap for Proton Inbox. You'll set the vision for the core inbox experience and manage a team of Product Managers. You'll work closely with engineering leadership, design, growth and marketing to turn that vision into a roadmap the team can execute against.

What you will do
Develop the Proton Mail product strategy to achieve business goals in terms of weekly users, revenues, ARR and P&L growth.
Drive the execution of the product roadmap from inception to launch, define product vision and strategy
Manage, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers
Work closely with design and user research to ground roadmap decisions in real user needs and behaviour
Job requirements
Proven experience owning a major product area end to end, ideally in consumer or productivity software at scale
Experience hiring, managing, coaching, and developing a team of Product Managers
In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more.
